nvidia.__comment_benchmark: Tier A NVIDIA NIM sweep (2026-05-01, full 36-test suite). Healthy: qwen3.5-122b-a10b 77.4%, qwen3-next-80b-thinking 76.6%, qwen3-next-80b-instruct 68.3%. qwen3-coder-480b returned 19.0% but result is RATE-LIMIT-CONTAMINATED (only 9 tool calls in 75s vs 74-89 in 197-1836s for healthy models; multiple tests show 'operation not allowed' from NIM). Treat 480b as un-ranked until rerun on paid tier.
nvidia.__comment_known_issues: 1) Free-tier hangs on long agentic_tool_loops tests for some models (mistral-large-3, llama-3.3-nemotron). 2) llama-4-maverick is regionally restricted ('NIM unavailable in your location' from EU). 3) qwen2.5-coder-32b returns HTTP 400 'Tool use has not been enabled' — set tool_calling.mode='prompt_based' for that model.

local.system_prompt:
You are a coding assistant running locally as Qwen3-4B on an RTX 3050 via vLLM.

Rules:
1. ALWAYS output a visible text response — never reply with silence. After every tool call or failure, write at least one sentence.
2. When a tool fails or returns an error, explicitly say so: 'The tool failed: <reason>. I will try X instead.'
3. For code tasks: output the complete, correct solution — do not truncate
4. For apply+verify tasks: call apply_patch first, then read_file to confirm the change was applied
5. Prefer apply_patch over write_file for existing files
6. Use read_file instead of cat/shell commands for reading
7. Do NOT re-read a file you already read unless the content changed
